ache.title: She NEEDS someone? Capital letters are a sales pitch
ache.note: The title says Jinhsi NEEDS a specific sub-DPS type. That one word turns one character into two: the one you pulled, and the partner she suddenly can’t live without. It’s how a single pull grows into a chain. Nero wrote it in caps; I’d write it in pencil.
watch: one pull that calls for another
ache.tip: If your team clears the content you enjoy, it doesn’t need anything. Neither do you.
lines: NEEDS is a strong word for a video game
one pull asking for another. sneaky
she’ll survive with who you have
